message:
As I was tidying up my home the other day, I stumbled upon some old boxes filled with little treasures and memories. It reminded me how important it is to not only cherish those moments, but also to be prepared for unexpected ones. I found this great resource that offers practical tips on putting together an emergency kit. 

It’s a wonderful excuse to gather the family and turn a bit of planning into a cozy event—think snacks, stories, and a little creativity as you put together supplies that can bring peace of mind. Preparing doesn’t have to be daunting; it can be a lovely way to spend time together. Have you ever made an emergency kit with your loved ones?
